biography.value:
Description

A monster that looks like a woman, and will turn to stone any who look into her eyes. Once a beautiful maiden, the medusa was turned into her current hideous form from the curses of those who envied her beauty. She now lives in seclusion, and shows her resentment to those who cursed her into her current form, the world itself, and any who she encounter by turning everyone and everything into stone.

Defense

AC 23, touch 14; flat-footed 19 (+4 armor [-4 without mage armor], +3 dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)

hp 126 [180] (12d10+60)

mp 47

Fort +9, Ref +11, Will +10

Immune Death, Petrification;

Resist Earth 20, Dark 15

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee +1 Dagger +16/+11/+6 (1d4+2/19-20), snake bite +10 (1d4 plus poison)

Ranged +1 Longbow +17/+12/+7 (1d8+1/x3)

Special Attacks Petrify, Petrifying Gaze

Spells Known (FC CL 12th, Concentration +16)

At will (DC 14) - Earth Orb, Message

1st (DC 15) - Entomb, Mage Armor, Sleep, Stone

2nd (DC 16) - Entomb II, Poison, Stone II, Stone Call

3rd (DC 17) - Bio, Entomb III, Sleepga, Slow, Stone III, Stonera

4th (DC 18) - Break, Poisonga, Rock Spikes, Stone IV, Stoneskin

Statistics

Str 12, Dex 17, Con 21, Int 18, Wis 14, Cha 18

Base Atk +12; CMB +13; CMD 26

Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (Longbow)

Skills Bluff +15, Climb +15, Disguise +15, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (Dungeoneering) +15, Perception +20, Survival +15, Stealth +15; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception

Languages Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Terran

Gear +1 dagger, +1 longbow, 20 arrows

description.value: A medusa's snake-hair allows her to see in all directions. Medusa gain a +4 racial bonus to Perception checks and cannot be flanked.

3/day, a medusa can focus her stony gaze upon a single target within 30 feet. The target receives the Petrification status effect (Fortitude save DC 20 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).

effect: Failed save: give the target Petrify: petrified (recipient). Activate on the recipient, not the caster.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).

description.value: 1/day, a medusa turns it victims to stone permanently within a 30-ft.-cone radius. Everyone within the effect must make a Fortitude DC 20 to negate the Petrification status effect. This is a gaze attack. The save DC is Charisma-based.

effect: Failed save: give the target Petrifying Gaze: petrified (recipient). Activate on the recipient, not the caster.

description.value: Bite—injury; save Fort DC 20; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d4 Str; cure 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.

effect: Bite injury: [[1d4]] Strength damage each round for six rounds; two consecutive saves cure.
Resolve Poison after a successful Snake Bite attack.

description.unidentified: A dagger is a fighting knife. Its blade is usually less than 1 foot long, and can be curved or straight, with one edge or two. Dagger designs vary widely, and can have many different names (such as a thrusting dagger being called a "dirk"). You get a +2 bonus on Sleight of Hand skill checks made to conceal a dagger on your body.

At almost 5 feet in height, a longbow is made up of one solid piece of carefully curved wood. You need two hands to use a bow, regardless of its size. A longbow can't be used while mounted. If you have a penalty for low Strength, apply it to damage rolls when you use a longbow. You can apply your Strength modifier to damage rolls when you use a composite longbow, but not a regular longbow. A longbow fires arrows.
